When he dropped deep, defenders were unsure whether to follow him, and when they hesitated, Xavi and Andrés Iniesta had time and space to control the game. This tactical setup became one of the key features of Guardiola’s Barcelona and was displayed at its devastating best in this match.

At half-time, Barcelona led 3–1, and the scoreline already reflected their superiority in both control and chance creation.
